Date :10-08-2026 
 
Subject: Submission of Audio Recording of earnings Conference Call 
 
Dear Sir/Ma’am, 
 
Further to our letter dated 30th  July 2026 intimating the schedule of Investor call at Monday, 10th  August 
2026, at 10:00 AM IST, we wish to inform you that the audio recording of the earnings conference call 
held today to discuss the Unaudited Financial Results (Standalone and Consolidated) of the Company 
for the quarter ended 30th June 2026 is available on the website of the Company and can be accessed on 
the web link:- https://ceigall.com/regulation-46-of-sebi-lodr/. 
 
The above information is also placed on the website of the Company www.ceigall.com 
 
You are requested to take the above information on your record. 
Thanking you, 
For Ceigall India Limited 
 
Megha Kainth
